ops.old: DunBroch braised lamb, neeps and tatties
ops.new: DunBroch braised lamb with neeps and barley

ops.old: Shoulder slow-cooked 3 hours with onion, carrot and barley, mashed swede and potato.
ops.new: Shoulder slow-cooked 3 hours with onion, carrot and barley, over buttery mashed swede.

ops.old: served with mashed neeps and tatties

Boil 800g peeled potatoes and 600g swede separately until soft. Mash the potatoes with 50g butter and milk, and the swede with 30g butter and pepper. Serve the lamb and barley over both mashes with the juices.
ops.new: Boil 1kg peeled swede until soft and mash with 50g butter and pepper. Serve the lamb and barley over the mash with the juices.
